$comment: Advisories accepted for the apps/web dependency tree, consumed by scripts/ci/audit-gate.ts.
An entry here does NOT silence the advisory: the gate still prints it on every run.
It records a reviewed judgement that the advisory is not actionable today, and the date
on which that judgement stops being valid. Past reviewBy, the gate blocks again.
Only high and critical advisories are gated; moderate and low are reported only.
Rules: every entry states what was checked, not just a conclusion. No entry may be added
for an advisory whose vulnerable code path is reachable in production.
Policy and triage procedure: docs/SECURITY.md section 6.

advisories.reason: libvips decoder CVEs reachable only through sharp's image decoding. Prodily never invokes sharp directly; it is present as a Next.js image-optimizer peer and as a devDependency of the brand asset generator, which processes repository-controlled files only. Locked-plan decision DEBT-07. Caveat recorded 2026-09-14: /_next/image is still enabled, so the optimizer path is not structurally disabled — this acceptance rests on decoder input being limited to the configured remotePatterns, not on the optimizer being off.

libheif CVEs in the HEIF/HEIC decoder. Same reachability analysis as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj: no direct sharp usage in application code, and no upload path accepts HEIF — apps/web/app/api/user/avatar restricts uploads by MIME type. Cleared by the same dependency bump.

sourceMappingURL file disclosure, build-time only. Requires an attacker-controlled CSS comment to reach the compiler; all compiled CSS originates in the repository. No runtime postcss invocation exists in apps/web.
Previous-source-map path traversal, build-time only. Same analysis as the other postcss entries: the compiler is never handed untrusted CSS at runtime.

Transitive through ajv via @hookform/resolvers, used for JSON Schema $ref resolution during client-side form validation. The IDN canonicalization confusion needs fast-uri to resolve an attacker-supplied URI; the only URIs it sees are schema identifiers written in this repository. No server-side fetch uses it.
SSRF via malformed IPv6 normalization. Same path as GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8 — ajv schema resolution only. Prodily performs no server-side fetch of a user-supplied URL through this dependency.
SSRF via repeated hostname percent-decoding. Same ajv-only reachability as the other fast-uri entries.
Host confusion via percent-encoded scheme normalization. Same ajv-only reachability as the other fast-uri entries.

CPU exhaustion parsing crafted YAML merge keys. Development-only: js-yaml is reached through eslint's @eslint/eslintrc and shadcn's cosmiconfig, neither of which ships in the production bundle, and both parse configuration files from this repository. Confirmed absent from the production tree by npm audit --omit=dev on 2026-09-14.
